name: orbit-night-caps-verify
description: ORBIT-NIGHT-CAPS: in orbit the ceiling is culled and the flat reads as a building SECTION, so the top of every wall box (y = ceilingHeight) is a visible cut face. The irradiance bake fills only ROOM-FACING atlas slots, so that TOP slot is empty and lightmapUv.ts:computeBoxAtlasUv mirrored the lookup to the BOTTOM row - at 20:00 every wall top glowed a bright white rim that the bloom then amplified. A section cut is not a physical surface, so there is no reference render to match; the caps now take the same uv1 = (-1,-1) sentinel an exterior face takes and keep three's analytic fill. Carries a second, smaller contributor: the faded wall-reveal panes' constant #eceae4 emissive lift, now scaled by daylight (revealLiftScale). This is the DEFAULT (orbitNightCaps=true) arm. 01-orbit-night is the defect frame; 02-orbit-day must be near-identical to the off arm (caps are lit by daylight either way); 03-walk-night is a control - in walk the caps sit under the real ceiling, so expect a near-zero diff. Captures the 'lightmaps:' boot line, which now carries the cut-cap count. Run with SHOT_GPU=1. Pair with orbit-night-caps-verify-off.json (SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=orbitNightCaps:off').

steps.name: capture-init
steps.eval: (() => { window.__caps = { logs: [] }; const info = console.info.bind(console); const warn = console.warn.bind(console); console.info = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__caps.logs.push(s); info(...a) }; console.warn = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__caps.logs.push(s); warn(...a) } })()

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(20); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 4.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()
